## How it works

- [statement] Referenced associations are not autosaved by default when saving their parent; enable `autosave` when required. Embedded documents are saved within the parent, and nested-attributes associations automatically gain autosave behavior. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/customize-association.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Mongoid coerces query values to a declared field’s type when constructing a query. Wrap a value in `Mongoid::RawValue` to bypass this coercion. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] A collection query can filter embedded fields using dot notation, but it returns top-level model instances even when every condition references embedded fields. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Callbacks customize model lifecycle events and can be implemented on top-level and embedded documents. The docs recommend testing callback chains and using callbacks for cross-cutting concerns rather than core domain logic. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/callbacks.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A persistent Mongoid model includes `Mongoid::Document`; typed fields can be declared with `field :name, type: String`. Instances can be stored in a collection or embedded in other documents. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/documents.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Embedded associations use `embeds_one` or `embeds_many` on the parent and `embedded_in` on the child. The child is stored inside the parent; multiple children are stored as an array field. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/documents.md
- [statement] Referenced associations support `has_one`, `has_many`, `belongs_to`, and `has_and_belongs_to_many`. By default, `belongs_to` stores the parent’s `_id` in the child document. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/referenced-associations.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Association callbacks `before_add`, `after_add`, `before_remove`, and `after_remove` apply to `embeds_many`, `has_many`, and `has_and_belongs_to_many`. Register them as association options and pass the added or removed document to the callback. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/callbacks.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Deletion paths have different callback semantics: document `delete` skips callbacks while `destroy` runs them; for embedded associations, `clear` and `delete_all` skip destroy callbacks while `destroy_all` runs them. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/crud.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md
- [statement] Mongoid query methods return chainable, lazily evaluated `Mongoid::Criteria` objects. Iterating results executes the query; chaining query methods merges filter criteria. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Embedded matching filters associations already loaded in the application without querying the server. Its supported operators are narrower than server queries: text, geospatial, JavaScript execution, `$expr`, and `$jsonSchema` are not implemented. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] A historical embedded-assignment performance investigation attributed increasing Ruby-side work to `object_already_related?`; Alex Bevilacqua profiled the issue without a database connection. This supports profiling association construction separately from database operations, not an unconditional claim that current releases retain the defect. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOID-4889 · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://alexbevi.com/blog/2022/09/09/performance-profiling-a-mongoid-issue-using-appprofiler/
- [statement] A persistent Mongoid model includes `Mongoid::Document`; model instances can live in a collection or be embedded, and saving converts them to BSON. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/documents.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Referenced associations support `has_one`, `has_many`, `belongs_to`, and `has_and_belongs_to_many`. By default a belongs-to child stores the parent identifier; many-to-many associations store arrays of associated identifiers on both sides unless the inverse is disabled. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/referenced-associations.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Query filters support Ruby field hashes, Query API operator hashes, and symbol operators. For fields declared in the model, Mongoid coerces filter values to the field type; `Mongoid::RawValue` bypasses that coercion. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] `elem_match` requires at least one array element to satisfy all supplied conditions and supports embedded associations. It does not join referenced associations; cross-collection querying needs an aggregation pipeline or separate queries. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/referenced-associations.md
- [statement] Mongoid provides document lifecycle callbacks for top-level and embedded models. Association callbacks `before_add`, `after_add`, `before_remove`, and `after_remove` are configured on `embeds_many`, `has_many`, or `has_and_belongs_to_many` and receive the affected document. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/callbacks.md · keywords: Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
